title: Implement InvoiceModule: auto-generate on OrderCompletedEvent
notes: Listen on OrderCompletedEvent. Create invoice in 'draft', persist, set status='issued', then update order.status='completed'. All in one DB transaction. Retry on failure, max 3 times.

title: Implement VAT calculation logic: group by taxRatePercent, floor rounding
notes: vatVnd = Math.floor(taxableVnd * rate / 100). Group order items by taxRatePercent. Must be isolated as a pure utility for unit testing.

title: Implement invoiceNumber sequence: per-store per-year, gap-free
notes: Use PostgreSQL SEQUENCE or table-based sequence with FOR UPDATE lock. Format: '{YYYY}/{seq:06d}'. Reset on year change.

title: Implement GET /orders/:id/invoice
notes: Returns invoice for a specific order. 404 if order not completed.

title: Implement PATCH /invoices/:id/cancel (accountant only, after refund)
